hypotheses.R1_rank8_is_not_a_unique_spectral_cut: The mean-projector eigenvalue ratio lambda_8/lambda_9 is below 1.20.
hypotheses.R2_candidate_cluster_is_weight_stable: At family ranks 16, 32, and 64, median within-cluster projector affinity exceeds median cluster-to-outside affinity by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.R3_sentiment_and_polarity_are_shared_dom: At shared ranks 8, 12, and 16, shared-like causal fidelity exceeds residual fidelity for sentiment and polarity on both corpora.
hypotheses.R4_gender_and_tense_are_residual_dominan: At every tested shared rank, residual causal fidelity exceeds shared-like fidelity by at least 0.20 for gender and tense on both corpora.
hypotheses.R5_scale_is_a_mixed_regime: At some tested shared rank on each corpus, both increasing-scale shared-like and residual causal fidelity are at least 0.30.
hypotheses.R6_cross_term_survives_rank_choice: At every tested shared rank, median shared/residual cross-term norm share is at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.R7_global_mean_basis_is_never_sufficient: At every tested shared rank, median global-mean-basis fidelity to the family patch is below 0.70 on both corpora.
hypotheses.R8_family_regime_transfers_ood: At rank eight, the sign of shared-minus-residual family fidelity agrees between FineWeb and TinyStories for all five families.
